title: AppState: ConnectionStatus, new fields, ANSI sanitize, status bar
description:
What: Add ConnectionStatus enum, chat_ids/contacts/message_state fields to AppState, add sanitize_display() utility, update draw_status() to show real status.

Algorithm:
1. In app.rs: add pub enum ConnectionStatus { Connecting, Connected, Reconnecting, Error(String) }.
2. In AppState add fields: pub chat_ids: Vec<String>, pub contacts: HashMap<String,String>, pub connection_status: ConnectionStatus, pub message_state: String.
3. In AppState::new(): init new fields to empty/Connecting/empty. Keep placeholder chat_list and messages — they will be overwritten by the data-loading beads.
4. In app.rs: add pub fn sanitize_display(s: &str) -> String that strips ANSI escape sequences (pattern: ESC [ ... m) using a simple byte scan without regex. Algorithm: walk bytes, when 0x1b seen followed by '[', skip until 'm'; copy all other bytes.
5. In ui.rs: update draw_status() to render format!(" {} | {}", state.connection_status_str(), chat_name) where connection_status_str() returns "Connecting"/"Connected"/"Reconnecting"/"Error".
6. In ui.rs: wrap chat_list display names in sanitize_display() (draw_chat_list line 77).

Defensive programming rules:
- sanitize_display must handle empty string and strings with no escapes as identity (no panic).
- ConnectionStatus::Error(String) must not expose internal error details in status bar — display as "Error" only.

Agent team: R reads app.rs and ui.rs; I implements; T writes independent unit tests with known oracle strings; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.

Tests:
- sanitize_display("normal") == "normal" (oracle: identity)
- sanitize_display("\x1b[31mRed\x1b[0m") == "Red" (oracle: manual strip)
- sanitize_display("a\x1b[5mb\x1b[0mc") == "abc" (oracle: manual)
- draw_status with ConnectionStatus::Connecting shows "Connecting" (TestBackend)
- draw_status with ConnectionStatus::Connected shows "Connected" (TestBackend)
